champion.builds: THE BEST DR. MUNDO BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR SUPPORT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Dr. Mundo Support build, you should take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Grasp of the Undying as your keystone, followed by Demolish, Second Wind and Overgrowth in the primary tree, as well as Approach Velocity and Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Health Scaling in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Celestial Opposition as your first item, followed by Boots of Swiftness and Heartsteel. For your last 3 items, you should build Warmog's Armor, Spirit Visage and finish with Thornmail. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 47.6% winrate over 126 matches played. Optional Your second option for Dr. Mundo Support build would be to take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Grasp of the Undying as your keystone, Demolish, Second Wind and Overgrowth in the primary tree, and Approach Velocity with Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Health Scaling in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Bloodsong, which you should build first, followed by Boots of Swiftness as your second item and Heartsteel as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Warmog's Armor, Titanic Hydra and Thornmail. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 46.3% win rate over 54 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Grasp of the Undying as your keystone, Demolish, Second Wind and Overgrowth in the primary tree, and Approach Velocity with Magical Footwear in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Health Scaling, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Solstice Sleigh as your first item, then Boots of Swiftness as a second item and Heartsteel as a third item. You want to finish the build with Warmog's Armor, Thornmail and Spirit Visage. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 47.1% win rate across 51 matches played. Situational Dr. Mundo Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Dr. Mundo build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Dr. Mundo runes page.
